method: as 77 with the radius running from 4 (x=0) down to 0 (x=40), where the round closes to the corner: the round is three-sided and the corner at x=40 stays (no ball reaches that section). The round is the union of the balls rolled along the edge, ball s touching both faces at r(s), the law continued past the edge's ends along its end slopes: each section loses the corner points no ball reaches, up to rho(x, t), the nearest entry into a ball along the ray from the edge at the angle t.
